# The Hunting Preserve
## Preserve etiquette - All participants must be established before the hunt by the huntsmaster, the Yautja releasing the prey. - Yautja may not join in the middle of a hunt except to observe, unless all existing participants have died or the huntsmaster consents to them joining after the start. - A preserve hunt is a hunt, not a thunderdome match. Yautja cannot goad humans into fighting each other, though the humans may do so of their own volition.
## Prey All prey on the preserve is [color=#57b339]worthy[/color].
- Prey who prove themselves by killing a Yautja in single combat can be allowed to leave through the escape gate. - Should only one prey be left alive after proving themselves, they can be offered the chance to go to the main part of the game. - Xenomorphs cannot be returned to the main part of the game, even if only one survives. - Prey may be taken from the preserve to the ship alive, but not to the main part of the game unless they have proven themselves on the preserve. - Thralls from the preserve, however, may be taken to the main part of the game.
## Dishonorable actions - Prey rushing Yautja buildings to breach them. - Prey being LRP towards each other or towards the Yautja. - Barricades and turrets.
## Trophy restriction Allowed preserve equipment trophies: - Unloaded, stripped guns. - Melee weapons. - Rank pins. - Helmets. - IDs.
Anything not on this list is not allowed.
All preserve prey bodies must be skinned and stripped of all gear before being taken to the main part of the game.
## Dathewi restrictions Dathewi may only be used on your thralls and on prey on the preserve. All other uses are not permitted.
For example, a youngblood fights cloaked and fractures a bone on their prey. You may give that prey dathewi to fix the fracture.
